newsitem.title: USA: Clinton opposes retroactive capital gains tax cut.
newsitem.headline: Clinton opposes retroactive capital gains tax cut.

text.p: President Clinton is against the idea of making a possible reduction of the capital gains tax retroactive, the White House said Thursday.
"The president has never thought that retroactivity makes much sense economically," White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters.
McCurry was asked about retroactivity because of Clinton's statement in an interview Thursday that he is willing to be flexible in dealing with the Republican-led Congress on a capital gains tax cut.
"I've never been philosophically opposed as some of my fellow Democrats are," Clinton said in his interview with New York television station WBIS+.
Clinton said in the interview he was against retroactivity because the loss of revenue from any cut would have to be made up elsewhere.
